# PromptVault

> PromptVault is a free, open-source, privacy-first AI prompt management tool and prompt engineering workbench. It offers offline-first browser storage, zero-knowledge client-side AES-256-GCM encryption, active session memory hygiene, AI-powered prompt evaluation via Google Gemini and Groq, dynamic variable template injection, and private cloud sync via Supabase.

## Core Resources

- [Web Application](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): The live, installable Progressive Web App (PWA)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/SagarBiswas-MultiHAT/promptVault): Full source code, architecture documentation, and issue tracker
- [Architecture & Docs Portal](https://github.com/SagarBiswas-MultiHAT/promptVault/blob/main/docs/README.md): Master technical documentation, C4 models, and ADRs
- [Security Threat Model](https://github.com/SagarBiswas-MultiHAT/promptVault/blob/main/docs/04-security/threat-model.md): Plain-English security invariants, STRIDE analysis, and cryptographic rules
- [System Architecture](https://github.com/SagarBiswas-MultiHAT/promptVault/blob/main/docs/03-architecture/architecture.md): 4-tier stack specification and component boundaries
- [Open Source License](https://github.com/SagarBiswas-MultiHAT/promptVault/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0 License

## Key Capabilities & Features

- [Offline-First Storage](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Instant local storage in browser localStorage with zero external telemetry
- [AES-256-GCM Client Encryption](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Secure local vault protection with 600k-iteration PBKDF2 key derivation, 6-digit PIN entropy, and one-time emergency recovery key
- [Active Session Memory Hygiene](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Decrypted prompt state is cleared and zeroed immediately upon manual vault lock
- [AI Prompt Analysis & Optimization](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Structured prompt evaluation, scoring (0-100), and automated improvement using Google Gemini 2.5/2.0 and Groq
- [Variable Template Injection](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Dynamic prompt parameterization with `{{variable_name}}` syntax and real-time form inputs
- [Supabase Cloud Sync](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Optional cross-device sync with Row Level Security (RLS)
- [Import / Export](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Full JSON data portability for prompt libraries and category structures
- [Usage Analytics](https://promptvault.multihat.dev/): Performance tracking, copy history, and extraction statistics
